about: Conservation laws and sanity principles the FlowWorks kernel must obey at the settings it SHIPS. Each law names the fuzz family of src/RimMandrake/Utils/vv_shipped_matrix.py that checks it and the exact assertion text in source; each family names a planted break that must turn it red (python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/vv_laws.py prove FlowWorks).

laws.sentence: The kernel's own ledger balances on every pulse: what it records moving in equals what it records moving out.
Water is conserved: total volume after a pulse equals the volume before, plus declared external input (rain, limitless sources), minus what sinks drained.
Every decilitre a sink drains is accounted to a sink cell that held it at the start of the pulse.
Each fluid is conserved on its own: no pulse turns one fluid into another.
No negative or overfilled cell: 0 <= fill <= depth <= 4 everywhere, every pulse.
A cell's exact water is never negative and never above its brim (depth x U decilitres).
A finite liquid body is never debited below zero: its stock stays >= 0.
With its inputs exhausted or steady, a scene settles: after the longest viscosity stride twice over it holds one state for 24 more pulses (no shuttle).
A level never may flow to its own cell (the flow order is irreflexive).
No pair of cells may each flow into the other (a level would shuttle).
Choosing between two different candidates always prefers exactly one of them.

check.text: PrefersCandidate not a strict total order

laws.sentence: A converter never runs more batches than its input, output room and accrued budget allow, and never leaves an affordable batch unrun.
A converter's accrued budget never goes negative.
Input consumed and output produced keep the recipe's ratio exactly.
No three cells may each flow into the next and back to the first (no 3-cycle).

plant.name: volume
plant.what: one whole level of water (U decilitres) appears from nowhere in a wet cell before a pulse

plant.name: bounds
plant.what: a dug cell's depth is set to 5 before a pulse

plant.name: shuttle
plant.what: one level is moved back and forth between two neighbouring wet cells on alternate pulses (volume and bounds kept)
equal depths may flow: the order becomes reflexive
batches are no longer capped by the input on hand
